source_note: The application source and candidate APK are committed together. Promotion copies identical validated bytes.
focus_note: Default hold freezes PASSIVE_FOCUSED continuous AF with AF_TRIGGER_START, then returns the trigger to IDLE after acknowledgement. Actual FOCUSED_LOCKED and stationary lens are verified before freezing exposure/WB. Explicit refocus uses CameraX AF-only metering without auto-cancel and reports failure honestly. Fixed lenses use AF_OFF. No lens-distance replay for AF locks; unknown distance is never replaced by 4 D. Manual focus is explicit.
processing_note: Noise reduction, sharpening, scene and video stabilization requests stay consistent before/after locking. Unchanged zoom is not resent.
compatibility_note: Retains v24 full-frame lossless color PNG and HD/FHD/QHD/4K selection. Rebind or zoom changes release the focus lock and require refocusing. Focus method is part of the calibration profile.

android_instrumentation.environment: Android 11 API 30 x86_64 with KVM acceleration and a virtual-scene back camera
android_instrumentation.promotion: Official download copies the identical tested bytes without rebuilding.
checks: Fixed-focus CameraX camera: exposure/WB confirmation, hold beyond 5 seconds, unlock/relock and quality rebind
Explicit refocus UI and fixed-focus fallback; moving-lens success remains a physical-device check
All four quality tiers, ROI controls and shared viewport rebind
Full 4K color evidence and native conversion checks from v24
Manual full-frame color, legacy grayscale, result viewer and failed-save rollback
android_instrumentation.camera_focus_observation: The successful virtual-scene run exposed a fixed-focus camera: AF mode OFF (0), AF state INACTIVE (0), distance 0 D. It validates the fixed-focus path and exposure/WB/UI/evidence behavior, not successful locking of a moving autofocus lens.

negative_autofocus_observation.outcome: The flat emulated camera reported NOT_FOCUSED_LOCKED (5) for both primary current-hold attempts. The app displayed failure and stayed unlocked. The positive-focus assertions failed in this fixture; this was not a successful autofocus validation.
